label: D2 after choosing a2, in the last ~8 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost only after the agent chose a2 (95% of mass, in_action==2), and only at the very end of the episode: 98% of mass is at episode trials 90-99, none before trial 80. Every activation falls in the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22), which is the end-of-episode drop in value, so the unit reads as an end-of-episode timer gated by the a2 choice. Rate goes up with ep_trial: the threshold 92 balances precision and recall (dev P 0.63 R 0.85 F1 0.72 mass 0.91); threshold 94 gives higher precision but lower recall. Adding a policy preference for a2 (choice < -1.52) only moves F1 to 0.75, so I recorded the simpler predicate. The largest activations are on a2 trials that reached S1 by a rare transition and on later trials, in episodes where S2 is good (start_high=1 carries 82% of mass). Never fires at D1/GO, on rewarded inputs, or before trial 80. Precision is limited: many late a2 D2 steps stay below threshold. Uses no future variables: the action is already observed at D2.
